title: RareEvent ClassificationKPI

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the RareEvent ClassificationKPI research task. Implemented the Temporal Stability Index (TSI) metric as specified: TSI = max(0, min(1, 1 − σ_d / (σ_x + ε))). Applied the metric to the model_output column of experiment_traces.csv (5000 samples). Key result: TSI = 0.968440 for the full series, indicating high temporal stability. Generated comprehensive analysis including 4 visualization figures and a full research report (report/report.md) with methodology, results, and discussion. All deliverables complete: analysis code in code/, intermediate results in outputs/, figures in report/images/, and final report in report/report.md.
